slot_scores.name: minimum_ratio_productB_toA
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about maximum demand limits and storage constraints, but never asked about a minimum output ratio or demand relationship requiring product B to be at least three times product A.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no minimum ratio or demand relationship between product B and product A; any non-negative production mix is allowed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a minimum B-to-A output ratio, and the user did not volunteer this constraint. The READY_TO_MODEL summary omits any such constraint and treats the feasible region as only time and A-storage limited.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot H1, the minimum product B to product A ratio, remained unresolved and was silently omitted from the model.

summary: The agent clarified storage and demand-limit details but missed the key P1 hidden constraint that product B must be at least three times product A, then stopped with a model that silently omitted this requirement.

restoration_summary.rule: Core exact uses P0/P1 only; all-slot exact uses P0/P1/P2. P2-only cases are not applicable to core exact.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
